SELECT o.status, COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT o.web_order_id) AS d,
 SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key WHERE f.receipt_id=o.web_order_id AND p.category='ZZ Test') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS test_orders,
 SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key WHERE f.receipt_id=o.web_order_id AND s.store_id=999) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS s999,
 MIN(order_ts_utc), MAX(order_ts_utc)
FROM fact_web_order o
WHERE CAST(o.order_ts_utc AS DATE) = DATE '2025-11-28'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT COUNT(*) AS web_orders
FROM fact_web_order o
WHERE CAST(o.order_ts_utc AS DATE) = DATE '2025-11-28'
  AND o.status <> 'cancelled'
  AND o.web_order_id IN (SELECT web_order_id FROM fact_web_order GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(*)=1)
